DICEY.Settings.Title: Things Got Dicey settings
DICEY.Settings.MenuHint: Holiday dice and how Dicey shows in Dicer's theme browser.
DICEY.Settings.Note: Your settings, on this device. Your GM may set some for everyone.
DICEY.Settings.NoteGM: Your settings, on this device. Everyone sets how much say players have.
DICEY.Settings.EveryoneHint: Player's choice, your value as their default, or your value locked.
DICEY.Settings.DefaultByGM: Your GM's default. You can change it.
DICEY.Settings.ChangedElsewhere: Changed elsewhere while this window was open.
DICEY.Settings.holidayDice.Name: Holiday dice
DICEY.Settings.holidayDice.Hint: Your dice switch to a holiday set while one is in season, and switch back after.
DICEY.Settings.holidayPick.Name: Which holiday set
DICEY.Settings.holidayPick.Hint: Random: a new set each time you load. Featured: the newest holiday's main set.
DICEY.Settings.holidaySkip.Name: Holidays to use
DICEY.Settings.holidaySkip.Hint: Untick a holiday to skip it. ★ marks holidays in season.
DICEY.Settings.holidaysInAll.Name: Holiday sets in All only in season
DICEY.Settings.holidaysInAll.Hint: The Holidays tab always shows every set.
DICEY.Settings.inSeasonFirst.Name: In-season sets near the top of All
DICEY.Settings.inSeasonFirst.Hint: After the sets you already use.
DICEY.Settings.holidayFx.Name: Holiday scene effects
DICEY.Settings.holidayFx.Hint: Fireworks, falling leaves or snow when you roll a holiday set. Needs Sequencer and JB2A. Starts off on Low dice quality.
DICEY.Settings.ResetAllHint: Resets every field. Nothing is saved until you click Save.
DICEY.Welcome.Title: Things Got Dicey
DICEY.Welcome.Intro: Your Dicey settings at this table:
DICEY.Welcome.NoneInSeason: No holiday is in season right now.
DICEY.Welcome.FxLow: Scene effects start off because your dice quality is Low. You can turn them on in the settings.
DICEY.Settings.NoDicer: Dicer is not active in this world.
